results.title: We Are Born Good
results.overview: A dining mishap caused a rift between Ji and Rui, leading to a cycle of revenge. Their already troubled lives only came together to fall apart.

results.title: Blessed Heart
results.overview: The true story of the sacred heart, told by Father Arturo Cornejo.

results.title: Clubfoot
results.overview: After fleeing his unstable home, an adopted teenager and his only friend abduct and violently assault a younger boy. As night falls, their lives begin  to unravel.

results.title: Luiza's Desert
results.overview: Luiza, a shy, awkward 15 year-old girl from Rio, dreams of being an artist. Her life is just starting to make sense when Luiza's world falls apart when her mother suffers an acute schizophrenic episode. Determined to hold her family together, Luiza must find the strength to face fear, loneliness and discrimination as she takes over the household and her mother's care.

results.title: Ice Gold: A Journey from Worst to First
results.original_title: Ice Gold: A Journey from Worst to First
results.overview: The true story of the underdog 2002 U.S. Paralympic Sled Hockey team that went from dead last to Gold Medal champions.

results.title: The Cuts
results.overview: Theatre faculty spar over outlandish financial schemes to keep their department afloat. The arts are worth saving - but can these bozos do it?

results.title: Posthumous
results.overview: After returning to her childhood home, Zoe discovers a mysterious videotape that unravels everything she thought she knew about her birth and her mother's death, awakening an unimaginable horror.

results.title: Secrets of the Bayeux Tapestry: Inside the Museum
results.original_title: Secrets of the Bayeux Tapestry: Inside the Museum
results.overview: The Bayeux Tapestry is one of the treasures of the medieval world. Across 70 metres of exquisitely embroidered scenes, it tells the story of one of the most seismic events in British history – the Norman Invasion of 1066.  For the last 950 years, this crucial part of Britain's national story has remained on the other side of the English Channel, in Bayeux, Normandy, but now it’s coming back to the UK.  A stellar cast of historians and experts follow the painstaking efforts to bring this priceless work of art back to the UK, where experts believe it was made, for a once-in-a-millennium exhibition at the British Museum.

results.title: MOFO
results.overview: While cleaning their late father's house, Joana and Tomás discover strange videos. As Tomás becomes obsessed with their meaning, subtle tensions arise between the two.

results.title: Red Ink
results.overview: In post-WWII New York, media propaganda, institutional power, and exploitation are interrogated amid the looming threat of a mysterious global virus.

results.title: SUBTERRANEA
results.overview: Fang Lin is a teenager who does not want to exist. Between a stifling environment and a falling out with her best friend, she feels utterly trapped in ennui. Meanwhile, the magic of Singapore’s natural world begins to rumble, threatening to break the leevee.

results.title: Megadeth: Behind the Mask
results.overview: Dave Mustaine reveals 40 years of Megadeth history and premieres their final album in a special event featuring career-spanning interviews and track-by-track commentary on this landmark release.

results.title: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai
results.overview: When a carefree orphan and a runaway minister's daughter marry on impulse, their love is tested by financial struggles and powerful enemies — from corrupt politicians to jealous rivals. Together, they uncover hidden truths and prove that love can survive even the darkest threats.

results.title: Something's Askew in Zonine Valley!
results.overview: In 1957, Natasha Pritchard remotely monitors an alien-infested New Mexico town to get herself off of Death Row.

results.title: Tripping With My Family
results.overview: Phương, an ambitious young startup founder, is forced to stage a picture-perfect vacation for her fractured family in order to secure funding for her venture. Can she overcome the challenge, mend family ties, and seize her chance at success?

results.title: Wind Up: The Movie
results.overview: A pitcher who can't throw strikes and his unlikely manager form a heartfelt bond.

results.title: The Oracle
results.overview: When an atheist psychiatrist hypnotizes his con artist patient, a message from his long-dead twin emerges. Is it the perfect con, or proof that reality is far stranger than he would like to admit?

results.title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
results.original_title: কেউ বলে বিপ্লবী, কেউ বলে ডাকাত
results.overview: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

results.title: INT. HALLWAY / NIGHT
results.overview: Int. Hallway / Night follows a comedy director replacing a director on an existential B-horror film, starring his adulterous wife and her lover. He soon realizes the plot eerily mirrors his darkest fantasies of revenge.
